name: Retailer Message 1 Code
definition: Identifies the type of process related to the message.

SSAB.name: Abort
SSAB.definition: Abort the current process or the last request.

SAAQ.name: Admin Request
SAAQ.definition: To select and start customised administrative services provided by the POI, using a "menu" for an interactive or software interface, initiated by the Sale system.

SDDR.name: Device Request
SDDR.definition: Request one or several functions of the device, from user Interface or payment peripherals on the POI system or on the Sale system. Functions can be Display, Input, Print, play sound, Card reader capabilities or Transmit a message.

SSEN.name: Event Notification
SSEN.definition: Notify the other party of an event that occurs on its side.

SSMQ.name: Message Status Request
SSMQ.definition: Request the status of a previous message for which the Sale system has no response.

SSMR.name: Message Status Response
SSMR.definition: Response to a Message Status request.

SSRJ.name: Rejection
SSRJ.definition: Reject a previous received message, for technical or functional reasons.

SARQ.name: Report Request
SARQ.definition: To request, by the Sale System, a report on a list of transactions on the POI system, or the status of a transaction.

SFRQ.name: Sale Financial Reconciliation Request
SFRQ.definition: Request a reconciliation (different types) between Sale System and POI System.

SFSQ.name: Sale Financial Service Request
SFSQ.definition: Request a financial service like payment, reversal, loyalty, Balance Inquiry, etc.

SFSP.name: Sale Financial Service Response
SFSP.definition: Response to a financial service request.

SASQ.name: Session Management Request
SASQ.definition: Request the management of a session: login, logout and diagnosis services. Initiated by the Sale system.

SASP.name: Session Management Response
SASP.definition: Response to a session management request to initiate/terminate a session.
